summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The JPMorgan BetaBuilders U.S. Equity ETF (BBUS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of US equities, selected and weighted by market cap. BBUS was launched on Mar 12, 2019 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.

holdings.infoBox: BBUS is an equity ETF with a total of 474 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.02%, Apple at 7.42%, Microsoft at 5.69%, Alphabet at 5.45%, and Amazon.com at 3.65%.
